name: OMNI-DC
plain: OMNI-DC: metric depth completion for any sparse pattern; it predicts depth gradients at three scales and integrates them with the sparse points, helped by Depth Anything V2 Large. BSD-3 code, weights non-commercial (they include Depth Anything V2 Large).
summary: OMNI-DC (ICCV 2025): zero-shot depth completion for any sparse pattern; an RGB-D network predicts log-depth gradients at three resolutions, a conjugate-gradient solve integrates them with the sparse depth, DySPN refines the result. Uses Depth Anything V2 Large as an extra input.

papers.title: OMNI-DC: Highly Robust Depth Completion with Multiresolution Depth Integration

limitations: The depth map is required: call the model with `prompt_depth=` a metric map in metres at the image size (another size is resized nearest; missing points as 0 / NaN / inf).
The weights include the frozen Depth Anything V2 Large (CC-BY-NC-4.0), so they are labelled non-commercial although the code and the Hugging Face card are BSD-3-Clause.
The integration is an iterative solve with a data-dependent step count: no ONNX / TensorRT export.
task_io: Input: one RGB image. Output: a depth or inverse-depth map. `kind` (a card field, `result.kind`) says what the numbers mean: `metric` = metres; `scale_invariant`, `affine_invariant`, `affine_invariant_log` (log depth) and `affine_invariant_inverse` are relative (unknown scale or shift, not metres). Metric models that use the focal length take `model(image, intrinsics=K)` (K `[3, 3]`, pixels of the input): `metric3d-vit-large` and `da3metric-large` need it for correct metres (`da3metric-large`: metres = output x focal / 300; without `intrinsics=` a 300 px focal length is assumed, wrong for a real camera). `unidepth-v2-vitl14`, `unik3d-vitl`, `depth-pro` and MoGe estimate the camera themselves (given `intrinsics=` replace `fx`); `zoedepth-nk` and the relative models (`da3mono-large` too) take none. Normals-only models (`kind` `none`) return `result.normals` `[B, H, W, 3]` (unit vectors, camera frame: x right, y down, z forward).

variants.name: omni-dc

licence.evidence: https://github.com/princeton-vl/OMNI-DC/blob/main/LICENSE (BSD-3-Clause, also on the Hugging Face card zuoym15/OMNI-DC); the checkpoint's depth_module is the frozen Depth Anything V2 Large (upstream loads depth_anything_v2_vitl.pth, CC-BY-NC-4.0)
licence.training_note: Synthetic RGB-D datasets with virtual sparse patterns per the paper (arXiv 2411.19278)

variants.input_size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model (ViT patch 16)

portable.protocol: first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

example.prompt: synthetic 24x32 depth, a tilted plane from 0.35 m (bottom) to 0.7 m (top)

parity.text: CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.005 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 1.5 % and p99 <= 5 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output `depth`).
